## About
All Star Muffler & Brake is a Conroe auto shop focused on exhaust and brakes. We also handle state inspections, auto A/C, tune-ups, oil changes and suspension work for domestic and foreign vehicles.
Our ASE-certified technicians use high-quality parts and work within your budget. If your car fails an inspection, bring it in and we'll take care of the failed components so you can get back on the road legally.
Neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 332 Google reviews. Call us, request service online, or stop by during the week.

## Services
- Performance dual exhaust: Exhaust work from performance dual exhaust to repairs and replacement.
- Brakes: Custom brakes, antilock and ABS brakes, pads and rotors for domestic or foreign vehicles.
- State inspections: We get your vehicle up to standard so it passes all state inspection requirements.
- Air-conditioning: We'll get your vehicle's air-conditioning running like it should.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I come in for a last minute inspection?
A: Yes. You can stop in even for that last minute inspection you need.

Q: What if my car fails inspection?
A: Bring it in and our technicians will take care of the failed components so you can get back on the road legally.
